title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content: Cover image: A lynx spider, Peucetia rubrolineata (Oxyopidae), drawn to the glandular trichomes of Trichogoniopsis adenantha (Asteraceae), whose defensive structures facilitate a facultative mutualism with predatory arthropods. See “Complex multitrophic species interactions and fitness costs: intricate consequences of jasmonate and salicylate induced plant defenses” (DOI: 10.1111/1365-2656.70243) for more information. Photo by Gui Becker.
